tasks.goal: Patrol perimeter of Charter Hall and scan charter display plinths for visitors
tasks.terrain: Thar Desert sandy-gravel flats with loose drift sand around plinth bases; low wind-blown dust obscuring lidar
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews patrol log and confirms plinth display areas are presentable

tasks.goal: Trot between rooftop solar panel mock arrays and capture thermal/visual panel imagery
tasks.terrain: Uneven concrete pad with panel mounting rails and cable trays; desert grit on walkways
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher approves imagery before it enters the evidence synthesis pipeline

tasks.goal: Stand at forum podium, gesture to proposal boards, and read proposal titles aloud for debate
tasks.terrain: Flat tiled forum floor; podium riser 5 cm step; low benches as foot-trip hazards
success: complete 6 proposal intros with correct speech
arm gestures within 10 deg of scripted poses
tasks.human_in_loop: A human moderator confirms proposal summaries are accurate before debate opens

tasks.goal: Sort task-routing cards into working-group bins at the operations desk
tasks.terrain: Fixed desk station; dusty cards causing gripper slip; bin dividers 8 cm tall
safety_stops: gripper slip retry max 3 then stop
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator approves the working-group routing map used for bin labels

tasks.goal: Place progress-marker tiles on the observatory metrics wall with sub-millimeter alignment
tasks.terrain: Vertical wall mounting grid with slot grooves; desert dust film on tiles reducing grip friction
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward verifies metric wall layout matches charter outcomes before tiles are placed

tasks.goal: Walk docent route through Charter Hall, pointing at contribution-model exhibits and speaking summaries
tasks.terrain: Compacted sand floor with occasional ripples; exhibit cables taped along route; 3 cm exhibit thresholds
success: foot placement clearance > 2 cm on thresholds
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews and approves the docent script tied to charter text

tasks.goal: Fly perimeter scan of Progress Observatory interior to baseline lighting and sensor coverage
tasks.terrain: Open high-ceiling hall; dust plumes from vents; ceiling-mounted progress banner rigging as aerial obstacles
success: complete 2 perimeter laps at 2.5 m altitude
safety_stops: range sensor reading < 1 m to obstacle evade-land
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves flight plan and confirms hall is cleared of people before launch

tasks.goal: Retrieve printed evidence briefs from trays and shelve them by topic in the lab library
tasks.terrain: Narrow library aisles 75 cm wide; brief stacks unstable on sandy dust film; floor cable runs to workstations
success: 8/8 briefs shelved to correct topic slots
tasks.human_in_loop: A librarian-style steward approves topic-to-shelf mapping before shelving begins
